messages:
maria: Heads-up — console charts started timing out for some users after the routing-weight bump around 13:10 UTC. Seeing 500ms -> 1.8s median on sparklines, and some full-panel freezes. Link to flame: https://internal/telemetry/trace/abcd

aj: Repro locally by toggling the route weight? I can repro in EU canary. Steps: open project X > metrics pane > hover.

sam: I grabbed the network waterfall from canary. Looks like several 1.2MB chunk downloads for chart-worker and shared-utils happen in parallel, then a flood of KV-prefetch requests. kvcache shows lots of evictions.

leo: Related to yesterday's routing change where we added route affinity to reduce tail latency — that changed how the client chooses bundle splitpoints. Might be causing duplicate shared chunks to download.

maria: Telemetry: CPU on the render workers is fine, but main-thread parse + GC time spikes. Telemetry trace: https://internal/telemetry/trace/ef12 — you can see repeated parse tasks at +200ms each.

olivia: Quick idea: can we short-circuit the prefetch when bundle size > 600kb? Right now prefetch fires blind on route enter. Might lead to thundering for big sharedchunks.

aj: Temporary mitigation: rolling back routing-weight to previous value fixed the canary (latency back to ~480ms). Can we do a targeted rollback on canary and run an A/B to confirm?

sam: Repro script I used (for QA):
```bash
# reproduce slow chart 
curl -H 'x-region: eu' 'https://canary-console/api/render?project=X&pane=metrics' 
# observe bundle list header in response
```

leo: Root cause hypothesis: routing-weight caused more users to land on the same splitpoint variant -> that variant references a newer shared chunk (big) plus a different chart-worker where our prefetch TTL doesn't match the kvcache sizing leading to eviction loops.

maria: Logs show kvcache evict_count spiked ~7x during the incident window. Also saw rate limit tripping on our prefetch service (quota).

olivia: Short-term action items:
- Revert routing-weight on canary (done by aj)
- Add a prefetch size ceiling and opt-out on large chunks (patch proposed)
- Increase kvcache LRU window on canary to avoid thrash

aj: Confirmed revert to canary at 13:35 UTC brought median down. I'll open a rollout ticket to pause the global rollout until we have the prefetch guard.

sam: For longer term: consider making prefetch adaptive to chunk size + network RTT and add de-dup across in-flight prefetches. Also ensure splitpoint discovery uses stable shared-chunk mapping to avoid unexpected duplication.

leo: Can someone add a quick telemetry panel: kvcache.evictions, prefetch.rates, chunk-download-size histogram per route. Want to see threshold where this flips.

maria: I'll add the panels and post results. Also assigning follow-ups: #1 prefetch guard (olivia), #2 splitpoint mapping audit (leo), #3 kvcache tuning experiment (sam).

deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-21T13:35:00Z rolled back routing-weight:v2 -> v1 (initiated by aj).

maria: Thanks. Keeping this thread updated with charts after the panels are up. :thumbsup:
